heroes.headline: COP31 runs into overtime with no deal
heroes.label: COP31: OVERTIME — NO DEAL · DAY 13
heroes.standfirst: Missed its Friday close. A draft silent on fossil fuels split 200 nations; a third text is due.

heroes.headline: Three Houthi missiles shot down over Riyadh
heroes.label: RIYADH: 3 SHOT DOWN
heroes.standfirst: Three intercepts lit the night sky on a third night of fire; the count for Saturday is three.

heroes.headline: Magnitude 6.7 quake shakes central Peru
heroes.label: PERU: QUAKE 6.7
heroes.standfirst: Struck 00:09 UTC, 108 km deep under Junín; Lima shook. No deaths reported by Saturday evening.

mids.headline: Overnight strike kills 2, injures 42
mids.standfirst: A double strike hit homes overnight; rescuers dug at dawn.

mids.headline: BepiColombo reaches Mercury tonight
mids.standfirst: Capture burn at 19:24 CET, after eight years and 150M km.

mids.headline: Rutte flies in for NATO talks
mids.standfirst: Allies weigh air defence after Poland's missile landing.

mids.headline: Jet lands safely, 146 aboard safe
mids.standfirst: Engine-fire alert on approach; all 146 walk away.

mids.headline: Rahul's 136 puts India on top
mids.standfirst: Century at the Basin Reserve; India 486 for 4 at stumps.

mids.headline: Verstappen takes Vegas pole

mids.headline: Trump vows tax on data centres
